removed_by: content fact-check, owner confirmed twice that this is not a real product
why: Duplicate identity: this row was named 'Women's Energy Booster (Femeez + Vit KD) for Period Energy' at Rs 400, while a separate published product 'womens-energy-booster' sells the same pairing at Rs 1,224.

Zombie slug: three blog posts still sold it under an older identity, 'Energy Boost Multivitamin & Mineral' at around Rs 400, which the row no longer described. One post recommended it as best-value multivitamin while recommending the real Women's Energy Booster four lines below as best for women.
Never ordered (0 orders), in no collection, stock 0, and after the blog links were repointed to Multiflux there were no remaining references anywhere in the catalogue, blog, pages or collections.
restore_note: To restore, re-insert the row below into public.products. The image file itself was not deleted from storage.
